# secureaccess_application_list (Resource)

This resource manages an Application List.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "secureaccess_application_list" "example" {
  name                     = "my_application_list"
  application_ids          = [1]
  application_category_ids = [40]
  is_default               = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The descriptive label for the Application List.

### Optional

- `application_category_ids` (Set of Number) The list of IDs of the Application Categories in the Application List.
- `application_ids` (Set of Number) The list of IDs of the Applications in the Application List.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Specifies whether the Application List is the default Application List.
  - Default value: `false`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import secureaccess_application_list.example "<id>"
```
